<Heading

  children={"Update Space Association for Automations"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/automations/space"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Batch associate a space for multiple automations.
- Automations not associated with any space will be newly associated.
- Automations associated with other spaces will be reconnected to the target space.
- Automations already associated with the target space will remain unchanged and be considered successful.
- If `spaceIds` is an empty array, clear the existing space association for the automation.
Return successIds / failedItems item by item. Partial success still returns code=0; all failures return code=2023, REST HTTP 400.
